task.title: Phase N start: governance redirect and visual capture + fingerprint foundation (library only)
task.objective: Owner request of 2026-10-12 after review: start Phase N under the existing awkit-vra numbering. S0 records the M-to-N redirect (Phase M deferred, non-blocking), the VC decisions this slice settles and the ones it defers, claims awkit-vra.1, files the fingerprint child under awkit-vra.3 and the new-scope OCR, row/grid and screenshot-state items. S1-S4 add a library-only src/visual module (viewport capture, coordinate mapping, bounds safety, protected-surface refusal, a pure PNG decoder, deterministic fingerprints and comparison), a mock-site visual lab, verifiers with mutation controls and an import-isolation guard proving no Runner, Recorder or preload code reaches the module. No execution influence, no persisted-shape change, no new dependency, no disk writes of captures.
